latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Creator v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export raw video footage using AI-driven cloud processing (no complex software needed).
- Supports uploading video files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and exports as polished 1080p MP4.
- Simple commands like "cut the pauses, add background music, and export" deliver finished videos quickly.
- Automatic, secure setup with token handling and session management — setup is fast and invisible.
- API-based workflow handles uploads, edits, exports, credits, and status queries with streamlined prompts.
- Designed for creators and marketers wanting fast, professional results without manual editing.
